product.name: ProWarm Electric Underfloor Heating Mat Kit 100W - 10m2
product.description:
The Floorwarmers Electric Underfloor Heating Mat Kit 100W offers a versatile solution for various floor coverings, ensuring exceptional reliability and hassle-free installation. Here's what you need to know about this kit:

Key Features:

Versatile Solution: Designed to cater to all types of floor coverings, offering exceptional reliability and hassle-free installation.
Long-lasting Warranty: Each product comes with a generous 25-year warranty, providing peace of mind and ensuring satisfaction.
Thermostat Options: A wide range of thermostats is available to enhance your heating experience, including advanced WiFi thermostats for smart home automation and stylish touchscreen thermostats.
Affordable Quality: Combines affordability with quality, offering excellent value for money and luxury of heated floors at an affordable price point.
Multiple Output Options: Available in 150W and 200W outputs, suitable for both primary heating and supplemental heating purposes.
Kit Includes:

Underfloor Heating Sticky Mat (Two individual mats if kit size is over 12m²)
Floor Primer: High-performance universal priming/sealing agent suitable for various substrates
Roller: High-quality roller for applying floor primer to the subfloor
Adhesive Tape: Assists in holding the mat or cable in position during installation
Digital Thermostat (if selected): Allows adjustment of heat settings for added convenience
Conduit
Specifications:

Cable Type: Twin wire cable 100w/m²
Cable Thickness: 3mm
Mat Width: 500mm
Warranty: 25-year manufacturer warranty
Tested: 100% earth screened
Cold Tail Length: 2m
Certifications: UKCA and CE Approved
Installation Guide:

Divide the floor into rectangles and calculate the area to be heated, covering approximately 90% with the heating mat.
Lay insulation boards over concrete floors to minimize heat loss and ensure quicker warm-up times.
Start laying the mat close to the thermostat, ensuring the loops are equally spaced and attaching the mat to the subfloor using the provided tape.
Install an RCD fused spur to power the thermostatic controller/programmer and the mat system, and lay the temperature probe equidistant between two cable loops.
Lay a thin, self-leveling screed over the mat or trowel flexible tile adhesive directly over the mat before laying floor tiles. Allow the adhesive to cure before switching on the system.
Note: Alternative brands of heating mats may be supplied during stock shortages.

Experience the ultimate warmth and comfort throughout your living space with the Floorwarmers Electric Underfloor Heating Mat Kit 100W.

Conduit
Specifications:

Cable Type: Twin wire cable 100w/m²
Cable Thickness: 3mm
Mat Width: 500mm
Warranty: 25-year manufacturer warranty
Tested: 100% earth screened
Cold Tail Length: 2m
Certifications: UKCA and CE Approved
Installation Guide:

Divide the floor into rectangles and calculate the area to be heated, covering approximately 90% with the heating mat.
Lay insulation boards over concrete floors to minimize heat loss and ensure quicker warm-up times.
Start laying the mat close to the thermostat, ensuring the loops are equally spaced and attaching the mat to the subfloor using the provided tape.
Install an RCD fused spur to power the thermostatic controller/programmer and the mat system, and lay the temperature probe equidistant between two cable loops.
Lay a thin, self-leveling screed over the mat or trowel flexible tile adhesive directly over the mat before laying floor tiles. Allow the adhesive to cure before switching on the system.
Note: Alternative brands of heating mats may be supplied during stock shortages.

product.name: Elnur Contract Ecohhr10Solar Storage Heater 0.8Kw
product.description:
The smart Elnur SOLAR High Heat Retention storage heater allows the use of energy from solar panels and other renewable sources, Wind, Geothermal, Ocean etc to reduce heating costs using free energy from renewable energy sources. When there’s not enough renewable energy production, it uses cheaper off-peak power to charge and provide heating.

Elnur's SOLAR High Heat Retention is the first storage heater on the market that can utilise a household’s solar or other renewable generation and converts the renewable energy into stored heat for delivery gradually into the room as required, providing the household with free heating. If the surplus production is insufficient to provide the heating desired, Elnur's SOLAR HHR can function as a conventional High Heat Retention storage heater by completing the charge during off-peak hours.

product.description:
Elevate your temperature control with the Mains Operated Non Programmable Thermostat. Designed for efficient control of a single heating zone, this digital thermostat offers reliable and straightforward operation without the need for programming.

Mains Operated: Powered directly from the mains, ensuring continuous and reliable operation without the need for batteries.
Single Zone Control: Suitable for controlling one heating zone, providing precise temperature regulation for enhanced comfort.
Rotary Dial: Features a convenient rotary dial for easy temperature adjustments. Simply turn the dial to set your desired temperature.
Delay Start: Program a specific time for the heating to start with the delay start function, ensuring your space is heated to the desired temperature precisely when needed.
TPI (Time Proportional Integral): Ensures accurate and efficient temperature control by adapting the heating output to maintain a consistent temperature.
Setback Mode: Activate the setback mode to temporarily reduce the temperature, saving energy when the space is unoccupied. Ideal for optimizing underfloor heating applications.
On/Off Control: Supports both On and Off control modes, allowing easy switching of the heating system as needed.
User-Friendly Interface: Designed for simplicity and ease of use, ensuring intuitive operation and hassle-free temperature adjustments.
Durable and Reliable: Built with high-quality materials for long-lasting performance and durability.
Underfloor Heating Compatible: Particularly suitable for underfloor heating applications, providing accurate and efficient control for optimal comfort.
Upgrade your temperature control with the Mains Operated Non Programmable Thermostat, offering simplicity, reliability, and precise heating regulation for your space.

product.name: Room Thermostat, Programmable, Recessed, Mains operated
product.description:
Upgrade your heating control with the EPH Recessed Programmable Thermostat. This mains-operated digital thermostat is specifically designed for recessed installation and is suitable for controlling a single heating zone, making it ideal for various applications, particularly underfloor heating.

Key Features:

Programmable Functionality: Set customized heating schedules to suit your daily routines and preferences. This programmable feature provides convenience and energy efficiency by ensuring your home is heated when you need it most.
Optimum Start: The Optimum Start feature calculates the ideal start time to reach your desired temperature at the scheduled time, ensuring your home is comfortably heated while minimizing energy consumption.
TPI Control: Utilizing Thermostatic Proportional Integral (TPI) control mode, the thermostat provides accurate and responsive temperature regulation. It continuously adjusts the heating output based on the difference between the desired temperature and the current room temperature, maintaining a comfortable environment.
On/Off Control: Additionally, the thermostat offers an On/Off control mode, enabling manual setting of the desired temperature and control of the heating system accordingly.
Experience precise temperature control and energy efficiency with the EPH Recessed Programmable Thermostat. Whether you have underfloor heating or other heating applications, this thermostat is designed to optimize your comfort and convenience.

product.name: Salus Controls 16Amp Hard Wired Relay for Electric Underfloor Heating RM-16A
product.description:
The RM-16A relay module offers versatile control for electrical devices, with the ability to enable or disable them as needed. Here are some applications of the RM-16A module in conjunction with other Salus products:

Thermostat Connection with Voltage Relay: Connect the thermostat (e.g., VS30/RT200/ERT20/ERT30/ERT50/VS10) to a gas-fired boiler requiring a free-voltage output NO/COM or NC/COM.
Thermostat Connection with NO/COM Relay: Link the SALUS thermostat with the NO/COM relay (e.g., 091FL) for boiler control needing NC/COM output, typically used in solid fuel boiler controls.
Receiver Connection: Connect a receiver with power requirements exceeding the relay's capacity in a regulator. Ensure the receiver's electricity consumption does not exceed 16A.
Connection of Non-Electro Thermal Actuators: Use with wiring centers (KL06-M/KL08NSB/KL08RF/KL10/KL10RF) to connect devices other than electro thermal actuators. For example, connect a pump or electric heating mat instead of an electro thermal actuator.
The compact size of the RM-16A allows for flexible mounting options, either in a flush-mounting box or where control of a receiver with a maximum load of 16A is required.

The Tile Backer Board is a versatile and dependable solution for tile installations, offering a range of benefits:

Water Resistance: This board is designed to resist moisture, protecting your tile installation from water damage and ensuring long-term performance.

Insulated Design: Crafted from high-quality extruded polystyrene, the Tile Backer Board provides insulation, enhancing energy efficiency and maintaining comfortable room temperatures.

Fibreglass Mesh Reinforcement: Embedded fibreglass mesh on both sides reinforces the board's structure, providing added strength and stability for your tile installation.

High Load Capacity: With an impressive load capacity of 30 tonnes per square metre, this board ensures exceptional durability, making it suitable for various applications and environments.

Compatibility with Underfloor Heating: Ideal for projects incorporating underfloor heating systems, the Tile Backer Board effectively prevents heat transfer into the substrate, maximizing the efficiency of your heating system.

Varied Foam Color: Please note that the foam color may vary, offering a range of options to suit different aesthetic preferences.

Enhance your tile installations with the Tile Backer Board, offering water resistance, insulation, and durability at an affordable price point. Whether for domestic or commercial applications, this reliable tile backer board is an excellent choice, providing peace of mind and backed by its quality and performance.

product.name: Viessmann Vitodens 200-W 80kW System Boiler B2HA 7571046.
product.description: Viessmann built the Vitodens 200-W 80kW system boiler as a wall-hung gas condensing unit for commercial premises, public buildings and apartment blocks. Equipped with a patented Lambda Pro Plus combustion control system, the appliance automatically adjusts to varying gas types and fluctuating gas qualities. This automatic control keeps system efficiency high without needing manual contractor readjustments. Flue gas inspection intervals extend to three years, which reduces maintenance work and cuts costs. To provide space-saving modular cascade setups, multiple boilers combine to deliver rated outputs from 2 x 49 kW to 6 x 99 kW. These cascade configurations fit into spaces with low ceiling clearances down to 1.9 metres.

product.name: Plastic Pipe Leading Bend 14-18mm Pipe
product.description:
The Plastic Pipe Leading Bend offers a reliable solution for creating tighter and more rigid pipe bends compared to the minimum allowed when the pipe is unsupported. It enhances flexibility and control during installation, ensuring optimal performance and efficiency in your piping system.

Improved Pipe Bend:
When working with plastic pipes, maintaining smooth flow is crucial to prevent any restrictions or kinks that may hinder liquid or gas flow. The Plastic Pipe Leading Bend allows for a seamless 90-degree bend without compromising pipe integrity, eliminating the risk of disruptive kinks that can cause pressure drops or blockages.

Enhanced Support and Stability:
Utilizing the Plastic Pipe Leading Bend ensures that your pipe system remains adequately supported and rigid at bends, even in areas with limited support. The bend provides extra reinforcement, minimizing the risk of sagging or deformation and maintaining a consistent flow profile throughout the piping network.

Easy Installation:
Designed for easy installation, the Plastic Pipe Leading Bend enables precise bends without requiring complex tools or techniques. Simply align the pipe with the bend and gradually guide it into the desired angle. The bend's flexibility and durability allow effortless shaping, saving time and effort during installation.

With the Plastic Pipe Leading Bend, you can ensure optimal flow, reduce the risk of kinks, and maintain a more secure and reliable piping system. Its ease of installation and superior performance make it an essential component for various plumbing applications.

product.name: Plumbright 0.16 Litre Shock Arrestor PV016E
product.description:
This Altecnic 0.16 Litre Shock Arrestor is specially designed to prevent the long term effects of water hammer, across a number of appliances & systems. Those would include Boilers, Sinks and Washing machines. 

The Altecnic Shock Arrestor consists of a Pressure Vessel, divided into two chambers by a flexible rubber membrane or diaphragm. 

A shock arrestor works on a heating system by using a compressible gas separated by a diaphragm to cushion sudden pressure spikes. These spikes in pressure are absorbed from WAter Hammer and thermal expansion, protecting pipes and components from damage and noise. When water suddenly stops, the kinetic energy creates a shockwave which the arrestor absorbs before it travels down pipework, preventing expansion stress

product.name: ProWarm Insulation Boards 6mm - ProFoam
product.description:
ProWarm ProFoam Boards are tailored to provide efficient insulation for our underwood heating and carpet heating mat systems, offering a budget-friendly solution without compromising on performance.

Key Features:

Compatibility with Underwood Heating Systems: Designed to seamlessly integrate with underwood heating systems, ensuring effective heat distribution and cost savings.
Underlay for Wooden Floors: These boards not only insulate but also serve as high-quality underlay for wooden floors, enhancing comfort and durability.
Not Suitable for Under Tile Heating Systems: Please note that ProWarm ProFoam Boards are not suitable for under tile heating systems; they are specifically designed for underwood heating and carpet heating mat systems.
Optimal Dimensions: Each board measures 856mm x 600mm, providing practical sizing for installation. With coverage of 0.51m² per board, a pack of 20 boards can cover 10.27m².
Cost-Effective Underlay: Even if not used with underfloor heating, they are the most cost-effective high-quality underlay for wooden floors in the UK!
Enhance the efficiency and comfort of your underwood heating or carpet heating system with ProWarm ProFoam Insulation Boards. These budget-friendly boards offer insulation and reliable underlay for wooden floors, providing a cost-effective solution without compromising quality.

Specifications:

Material: Expanded Polystyrene Sheet
Thickness: 6mm
Sheet Dimensions: 856mm x 600mm
Foam Density: 32 kg/m³
Thermal Conductivity: 0.034 W/mK
Compression Strength: 10 t/m²
Water Absorption: Less than 0.1 vol%
Impact Sound Insulation: 20 dB
Fire Protection Class: C Euroclass
Installation:

This product is laid staggered in a brick bond style.
If using with underfloor heating, the aluminium heating mat can be laid as shown.
Once the heating is installed and tested, wood floor installation may commence as instructed.

product.name: Ultra Prolevel Ultimate - Single Part Smoothing Underlayment - 20kg
product.description:
UltraTile Pro-Level Ultimate is a cutting-edge solution specifically engineered for use with underfloor heating systems. Its advanced formulation enables it to be applied on virtually any subfloor, including various substrates. This semi-rapid curing product allows floor coverings to be installed on top in as little as 4 hours, facilitating quick project completion. Pro-Level Ultimate is a high-performance, free-flowing single-part smoothing levelling compound, incorporating Ecosphere technology made with 20% recycled material for improved application and reduced environmental impact.

Key Features:

Designed for Underfloor Heating: Tailored to meet the demands of underfloor heating systems, ensuring compatibility and optimal performance in heated environments.
Apply Floor Coverings After 4 Hours: Offers fast curing properties, allowing floor coverings to be applied just 4 hours after application, reducing project timelines.
Suitable for Use Over Old Adhesive Residues: Can be applied over old adhesive residues, providing versatility and saving time on substrate preparation.
Contains 20% Recycled Material: Incorporates Ecosphere technology with 20% recycled material, promoting sustainability and reducing environmental impact.
Excellent Adhesion to Almost All Substrates: Ensures strong adhesion to a wide range of substrates, enhancing reliability and performance in diverse applications.
No Need to Prime (Under Certain Conditions): Eliminates the need for priming under certain conditions, streamlining the application process and saving time and effort.
Specifications:

Screed Classification: CT-C12-F5, indicating its suitability for various flooring applications.
Working Time at 20°C: Provides approximately 45 minutes of working time at 20°C, allowing sufficient time for application and levelling.
Walk-On Hardness Time at 20°C: Achieves walk-on hardness in 2-2.5 hours at 20°C, facilitating continued work progress.
Ready to Receive Floor Coverings: Ready to receive floor coverings in 4 hours with a 3mm application, enabling timely completion of projects.
Compressive Strength (N/mm²): Offers impressive compressive strength, with values of 10 N/mm² at 1 day, 12 N/mm² at 7 days, and 15 N/mm² at 28 days, ensuring durability and long-term performance.
Flexural Strength (N/mm²): Exhibits flexural strength values of 2 N/mm² at 1 day, 3 N/mm² at 7 days, and 5 N/mm² at 28 days, further enhancing its structural integrity.
Coverage:

Applied Thickness: Provides coverage per unit for various thicknesses, ranging from 3mm to 30mm, offering flexibility to meet project requirements.
Cleaning, Storage, and Shelf Life:

Cleaning: Tools should be thoroughly cleaned with water to remove excess material immediately after use, ensuring proper maintenance and longevity.
Storage: Store in a dry place at temperatures between 5°C and 30°C to maintain product integrity and performance.
Shelf Life: Under the specified storage conditions, the product has a shelf life of 8 months, ensuring product usability and reliability. High temperatures and humidity may affect shelf life and should be avoided for optimal performance.
Enhance your flooring projects with UltraTile Pro-Level Ultimate, a high-performance solution designed to meet the rigorous demands of underfloor heating installations while promoting sustainability and environmental responsibility.

Whether two, four or more cylinders the CTR800 OPSO ensures reliable pressure delivery and consumer safety with the new over pressure protection system. No need to remove caps or pull resets just a clear “Push to Set device cancelling the red trip indicator. The latest in the range of Compact regulators for LPG cylinders is developed and manufactured by Clesse in France using the new patented OPSO design.

The design team re-evaluated the way consumers interact with LPG, its safety and suitability for modern appliances of today.

The gas valve is a device that regulates the flow of gas within a heating system for optimal performance and ensuring the correct operational temperature is reached. It works by controlling the volume of gas supplied via an open / close valve when an instruction is sent from the PCB to signal the demand. When signalled, the valve opens, allowing the flow of gas into the burner or pilot assembly.

product.name: Valway Panel Riser Kit for Square and Rectangle Shower Trays up to 2000mm
product.description: The Valway panel riser kit is designed for raising square and rectangular shower trays up to 2000mm in width. Suitable for installations where under-tray clearance is limited, such as on solid floors, this riser kit creates a 95mm lift to allow practical access for fitting shower waste and pipework. The kit includes components needed to securely support the shower tray and keep it stable in a variety of bathroom layouts. All elements can be trimmed to fit trays of different shapes and sizes within the specified maximum dimensions. This product is suitable for both trade professionals and DIY installers seeking a reliable solution for elevated shower tray installations.

product.name: Valway Panel Riser Kit for Square and Rectangle Shower Trays up to 1000mm
product.description: The Valway Panel Riser Kit is designed for use with square and rectangular shower trays up to 1000mm in width, providing a practical solution where additional height is required for plumbing waste connections. Suitable for both trade and domestic installations, this riser kit allows shower trays to be raised by 95mm, making pipework and waste installation straightforward without the need for complex sub-floor alterations. The system is supplied with adjustable feet and durable panel components, ensuring secure and level support across the underside of the tray. Ideal for installations where raising the tray is necessary, this kit facilitates easy access for ongoing plumbing maintenance, while its robust build is intended to support daily use in modern bathroom settings. The Valway riser kit is a reliable choice for accommodating plumbing beneath shower trays while maintaining a professional finish.

product.name: Valway Panel Riser Kit for Quadrant Shower Trays - 1200mm
product.description: The Valway panel riser kit is designed for use with quadrant shower trays up to 1200mm in width, providing a practical solution for installations where access beneath the tray is required. By raising the shower tray 95mm above floor level, this riser kit enables straightforward plumbing connections for wastes, making it especially useful in settings with solid floors that cannot be modified easily. The kit includes a single curved panel that fits quadrant-shaped trays, offering a consistent and neat finish by concealing the tray supports and attachment points. Adjustable legs with circular base plates are included for stable installation and support. The panel riser kit is supplied with all necessary fixtures to ensure compatibility with the specified shower tray dimensions and shapes.

product.name: Valway Return Panel - 8mm Black
product.description: The Valway return panel is a hinged glass shower screen designed for use in modern wet rooms or as part of a shower enclosure. Manufactured with 8mm thick clear glass, this panel is both robust and practical for daily bathroom use. The frameless construction and matte black profile create a contemporary finish, blending seamlessly with a range of bathroom styles. Measuring 300mm in width and 1950mm in height, the panel offers extended splash protection and is well suited to spaces where a taller panel is required. An easy-clean coating helps to reduce maintenance by making it simpler to keep the glass clear of residue. The return panel is intended to be installed alongside a compatible main shower screen to complete the enclosure set-up. Its hinged design allows the panel to open, providing flexibility in access or layout. This product serves as a functional and attractive choice for updating a shower area, particularly in settings seeking a minimalist aesthetic. The Valway return panel is suitable for both trade and private installations where quality, safety and streamlined style are priorities.

product.name: Valway Return Panel - 8mm
product.description: The Valway hinged return panel is designed for wet room and shower enclosure installations where a sleek, frameless glass partition is required. Constructed from 8mm thick clear toughened safety glass, this return panel offers both durability and a minimalist appearance. The glass is treated with an easy-clean coating, making maintenance straightforward and helping to keep the panel clear over time. The panel measures 300mm in width and 1950mm in height, providing extended coverage for improved splash protection compared to standard shower screens. The frameless format, complemented by a chrome profile, contributes to a modern, open look in the bathroom. This hinged return panel is intended as an add-on to a compatible main shower screen, offering flexible access or additional water retention within a shower area. Suitable for both residential and commercial wet room applications, the Valway panel is a practical choice for updating or installing a shower zone where space efficiency and streamlined design are priorities.

product.name: Valway Thermostatic Dual Head Exposed Mixer Shower - Chrome
product.description: The Valway thermostatic dual head exposed mixer shower in chrome is a complete shower kit designed for use with high pressure and combi boiler water systems. This exposed mixer shower features two separate outlets: a 200mm round rainfall drencher head mounted on a 450mm projecting shower arm, and a handheld shower with a 1500mm flexible hose. Both heads can be used simultaneously for versatile showering options. Thermostatic temperature control maintains consistent water temperature and protects against sudden changes during use. The shower valve has classic cross head controls for managing water flow and temperature, and is constructed from solid brass with a polished chrome finish. White ceramic detailing on the controls and handset adds a traditional accent to the unit. The riser rail measures 860mm in height and has a tube diameter of 19mm. The system is suitable for supply pressures between 0.5 and 5 bar, with a minimum maintained pressure of 0.5 bar for optimal operation. Pipe centres are adjustable between 140-160mm to support straightforward installation. This mixer shower does not include mobile or smart home connectivity. The wall-fed exposed installation is ideal for modernising bathrooms where stability and accessibility are priorities. The Valway thermostatic dual head exposed mixer shower is engineered for reliability and suitable for bathrooms seeking a combination of style and robust performance.

product.name: Riello 20193432 Photodiode Analogue
product.description: The photocell in an oil burner is used as a safety device, it monitors the combustion chamber for a flame signal. It provides a monitored feedback signal back to the Control PCB. During the start-up process the photocell checks there isn't a flame or stray light in the chamber, only then does the PCB allow the system to start the next phase and establish the flame. Once the flame has been lit the photocell starts to monitor that the flame remains lit, if the flame signal is dropped the PCB will initiate a burner lockout.

product.name: JG Speedfit Layflat Polybutylene Plastic Pipe Coil 15mm x 25m White 15BPB-25C
product.description: Manufactured by JG Speedfit, this 15mm x 25m polybutylene plastic pipe coil features a white finish and carries both BSI and WRAS approval. The non-toxic 5-layer polybutylene construction incorporates a central tinted oxygen barrier that blocks air ingress to protect metal system components from corrosion. Designed to uncoil flat without retaining shape memory, this lightweight polybutylene pipe routes easily through timber joists and long runs. Requiring fewer mechanical fittings than rigid copper pipe, the flexible system lowers installation costs while reducing potential leak points. Suitable for underfloor heating and general plumbing, this plastic pipe operates without the need for hot works or soldering equipment. The product comes under part code 15BPB-25C.

product.name: JG Speedfit Layflat Polybutylene Plastic Pipe Coil 22mm x 25m White 22BPB-25C

Both BSI and WRAS approved, the 22BPB-25C product uses a five-layer polybutylene design that lies flat once uncoiled without retaining shape memory. A central coloured barrier blocks oxygen to prevent air ingress and protect metal components from corrosion. 

Its non-toxic, flexible plastic construction allows simple cabling through joists and long pipe runs without requiring hot works. Compared to standard copper systems, this flexible barrier pipe requires fewer push-fit fittings, reducing installation labour, material costs and potential leak locations.

The primary is present in almost all boilers and it allows the transfer of heat from the burner to the water within the system. The secondary heat exchanger is only found in a combi boiler and allows the heat to be transferred between multiple closed systems. The Primary Heat exchanger is sometimes referred to as the 'main' heat exchanger or heat engine. The secondary heat exchanger can also be known as the plate heat exchanger or the domestic hot water heat exchanger .
Compatiable With:- CDi Combi 25/30, 28i Junior, 30Si FSN/FSP & 29CDi Classic

product.name: Grohe Grohtherm  Perfect Shower Set With Rainshower Cosmopolitan 210
product.description:

product.description:
Indulgent showering and fun with water on a budget: high-quality shower system with thermostatic mixer for the bath tub
The Vernis Blend 200 shower system with thermostatic mixer for the bath tub (1 jet type) combines the hand shower, overhead shower and thermostatic bath mixer in an attractively priced package. The 205 mm overhead shower pampers with an even, luxurious water flow here (XXL Performance). The powerful Rain jet offers an invigorating burst of freshness for the entire body. Yet another advantage: As the shower head can be individually adjusted (angle: +/-15°), hair can be kept dry, if needed. Diverting from the bath filler to the shower head is also highly convenient: One touch of the user-friendly diverter is all it takes for the indulgent showering to begin.
Great lengths for convenience in tried-and-tested hansgrohe quality
The 1.60 m long shower hose allows plenty of room to move. Comfortable, safe and indulgent showering: The high-quality hansgrohe thermostatic bath mixer is reliable at maintaining the set temperature. A safety lock protects against excessively hot water (SafetyStop). Users need to press a button if they want a hotter temperature.
Other features
• Always to hand: The shower head is always neat, tidy and easy to reach with the practical shower support
• Easy care: Limescale can be removed by simply wiping the silicone nozzles on the shower head (QuickClean)
• Dazzling look: The permanent shine of the brilliant, low-maintenance chrome finish impress time and time again
• Guaranteed availability: Spare parts can be purchased up to 15 years after the range has been discontinued

product.description:
The Reliance CPT15 pressure and temperature relief valve has been designed to provide protection against over pressurization, which can occur within an unvented hot water cylinder system if the input temperature controls fail. The CPT15 pressure & temperature relief valve is designed to be fitted in the upper portion of the unvented cylinder as this is where the hottest system temperatures will be found.

 

If the system temperature rises beyond 95° C, the wax mixture within the element of the temperature probe will expand, causing the valve to lift off its seat and relieve water to waste. If the water pressure increases (without temperature increase) the CPT15 temperature & pressure relief valve will stay closed until the set pressure of the relief mechanism is reached, at which point the valve will open to relieve the excess pressure build-up.

Each tube undergoes rigorous testing and quality control measures to meet and exceed industry benchmarks. Made with precision engineering to ensure exact dimensions and a perfect fit every time. This meticulous attention to detail guarantees seamless connections and leak-free performance, which is crucial for the integrity of any piping system. When precision matters, Wednesbury Copper Tube delivers outstanding accuracy and dependability.
Professionals across the plumbing and HVAC industries trust Wednesbury Copper Tube for its reliability and performance. With decades of experience and a reputation for excellence, Wednesbury Copper Tube has become the go-to choice for experts who demand the best. product.name: Tapworks Domestic Automatic Water Softener for 1 to 9 Person Household NSC14PRO
product.description: For larger homes suitable of 1-9 people (*based on usage of 140l per person at 300ppm). NSC14PRO automatic water softener has a one-piece design. Like the other Tapworks domestic water softeners its operation is based on the proportional volumetric regeneration. Again, the NSC14PRO has compact enough dimensions to allow installation in smaller spaces. The LCD display is backlit making data reading simple even in basements or poorly lit places. A domestic water softener protects pipes, boilers and appliances that use water such as washing machines, dishwashers and coffee machines. All of the Tapworks NSC range come with an in tank light as standard, making salt refills easy. A Tapworks water softener extracts the hard minerals from the water in your home, which means you experience truly softened water. Tapworks' clever technology means you always have soft water on demand. The NSC14PRO water softener is simple to commission and requires NO specialist work. In fact, to start the unit you only need to set two parameters - time and hardness. The salt cabinet is made of polyethylene to prevent it from deforming when full unlike inferior products widely available on the market. Quality first. Units are supplied with a high flow and performance by-pass valve and hoses in the box; making Tapworks units easy to assemble and install. Each unit comes with a mixer to adjust the hardness and safety float in the salt cabinet to avoid unwanted spillages. During normal operation the salt cabinet remains dry and the user can continue to use softened water during the first phase of regeneration standard with Tapworks water softeners. Tapworks softeners come equipped with advanced electronics as standard and at no additional cost. Maintaining statistical and programming data even in the event of a blackout. On the backlit LCD display you can view usage data such as hardness, time, remaining exchange capacity, water softened from the previous regeneration as well as average water consumption in the last 7 days. Tapworks offer this level of controls and access as standard. The intelligent controller can perform an electrical self-diagnosis, keeping track of the days of operation, total number of regenerations carried out, while checking the turbine and switches are working efficiently.

product.name: Worcester Bosch Heat Exchanger 8716122564
product.description: The Worcester Bosch Heat Exchanger 8716122564 is a genuine Worcester Bosch spare part with a Worcester Bosch manufacturer's guarantee. The Heat Exchanger is a vital component that facilitates the transfer of heat from the burner to the water within a heating system. These parts are categorised into two separate types, the Primary Heat Exchanger and the Secondary Heat Exchanger. The Primary is found within almost all boiler systems whereas a Secondary is only found within Combination systems to allow the heat to be transferred between the two closed systems.

product.description: Grundfos Unilift AP12 pumps are designed for pumping clean non-aggressive water and drainage- and greywater with particles up to 12mm. The pumps are suitable for temporary as well as permanent free-standing installations. The blades are curved backwards to reduce any harmful effect from solid particles and to minimise power consumption. The shaft seal is a combination of a mechanical, bellows shaft seal and a lip seal with 60 ml oil between. Seal faces are made of silicone carbide. product.name: Enphase IQ8AC Micro Inverter With Integrated MC4
product.description: The Enphase IQ8AC micro inverter with integrated MC4 delivers a 96.6% EU efficiency rating for optimised solar energy conversion. This lightweight, compact unit utilises plug-and-play connections to simplify handling on site. Installers can complete projects faster using simple two-wire cabling. A built-in rapid shutdown mechanism secures compliance with stringent safety regulations. The system manages data transfer via power line communication between individual components. This unit carries CE certification and meets European legal standards when fitted according to manufacturer guidelines. Enphase subjects this technology to over one million hours of collective inrush testing to support a 25-year warranty.

product.name: Enphase IQ Battery 5.0KWH
product.description: Enphase has engineered this fully integrated AC storage system to manage domestic power distribution. The unit provides 5.0 kWh of usable electrical capacity to support household loads. Six built-in microinverters manage grid connection to deliver a constant power output of 3.2 kVA. product.description:
Charge your electric vehicle with GivEnergy’s
solar diverting 7kW EV Charger. The EV Charger is a new member of the GivEnergy family.
Compatible with most plug-in electric cars, the EV charger can
be installed on its own, alongside a solar system, or with a
GivEnergy battery system. It allows you to charge from excess
generation, from the grid, and from your battery storage
system. Its compact and waterproof design allows for installation in
tight spaces both indoors and outdoors. Integrated WiFi
allows for easy control of your vehicle’s charge via the
GivEnergy Monitoring Portal or App.

product.name: GivEnergy 2.6kWh Battery - GIV-BAT2.6
product.description:
The 2.6kWh battery pack is ideal for New Build and
Social Housing Projects where smaller storage
capacity is required to start that can then be
increased over time. Due to its small and compact design, it is suitable for
installation in loft spaces or hard to access areas. Can be
banked together to reach the desired capacity for the
household.
Utilising lithium iron phosphate technology, our batteries
are extremely safe and can be installed in a wide range of
locations. The battery chemistry does not contain any
Cobalt, making it non-flammable and the battery pack is
99% recyclable.

product.name: GivEnergy 3.0KW Singler Phase AC Coupled Battery Inverter - GIV-AC3.0
product.description:
GivEnergy designed the GIV-AC3.0 as a 3.0kW single phase AC coupled battery inverter that integrates with grid-tied renewable power sources. This unit operates as an independent storage system or pairs with wind turbines, hydro equipment, and solar panels to capture surplus generation. 

Installers can add the unit to an existing solar PV system without affecting UK government incentive payments. The system optimises split-rate energy tariffs such as Economy 7 by drawing power to top up the battery during low-cost off-peak periods. It releases stored electricity during expensive peak hours, reducing reliance on grid power and lowering electricity bills. GivEnergy supplies this model with a 12 year manufacturer warranty alongside UK based technical support.

product.name: GivEnergy 9.5kWh Battery - GIV-BAT9.5
product.description: GivEnergy designed the bestselling 9.5kWh capacity GIV-BAT9.5 battery pack using non-flammable, cobalt-free lithium iron phosphate that is 99% recyclable. An IP65 rated enclosure protects the battery from water and dust ingress, making it suitable for loft space or outdoor installation. This standalone 9.5kWh unit charges off-peak or integrates into an existing solar PV setup as a retrofit without altering government incentive payments. Suitable for medium or large homes seeking energy independence, installers can fit two 9.5kWh units to minimise grid power consumption. A 12-year manufacturer warranty covers the GIV-BAT9.5 model, supported directly by a UK-based technical team.

product.name: GivEnergy 3.6kW Singler Phase Hybrid Inverter Generation 3
product.description:
The third generation of the GivEnergy Hybrid
Inverter is a battery and solar inverter in one
unit.It can be coupled directly with solar panels to generate
usable electricity in the property as well as store any excess
energy for later use in a battery. The Hybrid Inverter aims to
minimise export by storing excess energy in the battery
during generation hours. Additionally, it will minimise import
by discharging to meet demand in the property.

product.name: GivEnergy 5.0kW Singler Phase Hybrid Inverter Generation 3
product.description: The GivEnergy GIV-HY5.0 G3 is a single-phase generation 3 hybrid unit that combines a solar inverter with a battery inverter to process up to 5.0kW of power. Direct connection to solar panels allows this unit to convert photovoltaic generation for immediate property use or divert excess production into storage. Storing surplus power during daylight hours lowers grid exports, while discharging battery power to meet household loads reduces grid imports. Built with a discharge rate reaching 3.6kW, the system supports flexible rate tariffs by charging off-peak and discharging at peak usage times. An integrated network interface features both in-built WiFi and a LAN port for a hard-wired connection. GivEnergy covers this inverter with a 12-year manufacturer warranty supported by a UK team.

product.name: GivEnergy 6.0KW / 13.5kWh All in One Energy Storage
product.description:
British manufacturer GivEnergy designed the GIV-AIO-13.5-AC system with a 6.0kW power output and 13.5kWh usable capacity for residential and commercial solar PV setups. Running on-grid, it delivers 7.2kW peak power alongside current solar panel generation. 

The modular casing contains four removable battery units to simplify handling during installation. For larger properties, multiple units can be fitted in parallel to increase overall storage capacity. 

Wiring the unit with a GivEnergy Gateway provides off-grid backup power to the whole house during grid failures. Compatibility with flexible rate tariffs lets you charge the unit off-peak when electricity rates are lower, then discharge during peak demand. This grid services ready system also enables energy suppliers and aggregators to pay users for reducing electrical usage at specified times.

product.name: GivEnergy All in One Gateway
product.description:
By purchasing the additional Giv-Gateway, the
All in One can provide whole house backup in the
event of a grid failure. The Giv-Gateway provides seamless switching between grid
and battery ensuring that your property is always powered.
The Giv-Gateway also facilitates a connection point for your
solar PV system by allowing it to continue to generate
energy even without a grid supply.

product.name: testo 565i Smart vacuum pump 10 CFM 0564 5653 02.
product.description:
The new testo 565i vacuum pump performs refrigeration system and heat pump evacuations completely automatically. Once the desired vacuum target value is reached, pumping is automatically stopped and a vacuum hold test is initiated at the same time. Foreign gases and moisture can thus be removed safely, and data relating to the system's leak-tightness stored.

The data logging function ensures complete documentation. This allows evacuations to run completely independently - for maximum accuracy and efficiency.

Configuration, monitoring of live readings and sending of the measurement report are all easily controlled via the free testo Smart App. This allows you to remain flexible and saves valuable time.

To ensure perfect interaction between workflows, when the testo 565i is switched on, it automatically establishes a Bluetooth connection to the Testo measuring instruments and also the Smart App. The pump also guarantees maximum safety at all times thanks to its compatibility with A2L and A3 refrigerants.

Maximum convenience is guaranteed by the simple oil change mechanism and the sight glass for quick assessment of the oil level, along with the ergonomic handle.

To ensure high reliability, the built-in non-return valve provides effective protection against loss of vacuum, even in the event of unexpected power failures, and offers an extra layer of safety for uninterrupted operation.

product.name: Heatmiser 2 Wire Thermal Actuator Ta230 Control
product.description:
The Heatmiser thermal actuator TA230 is a reliable and efficient 2-wire thermal actuator designed to control individual valves on a manifold system. When prompted by a room thermostat, the thermal actuator opens the valves, enabling precise control of the heating in each room or zone. To seamlessly integrate into your underfloor heating system, the Heatmiser thermal actuator is typically wired into an underfloor heating wiring centre, such as the Heatmiser UH4 or UH8. This enables centralized control and synchronization of the thermal actuators throughout the system, ensuring optimal performance and energy efficiency. For convenient installation, the thermal actuator comes complete with a threaded ring nut M30 x 1.5. Prior to fitting the actuator, the threaded ring nut is securely screwed onto the manifold, providing a sturdy base for attaching the actuator. The actuator easily clips onto the threaded ring nut, streamlining the installation process and saving valuable time. Operating on a 230V power supply, the Heatmiser thermal actuator ensures consistent and reliable performance. With its 2-wire normally closed configuration, the actuator efficiently controls the flow of heating water, allowing for precise temperature regulation and comfort control in each room or zone. The stroke length of the thermal actuator is 3.5mm +/- 0.5, providing the necessary movement to open and close the valves with accuracy and precision. This ensures smooth and responsive operation, allowing for precise adjustment of the heating flow in response to the room thermostat signals. Choose the Heatmiser thermal actuator - 2 Wire for your underfloor heating system and experience efficient, reliable, and customizable control of your heating zones. With its robust construction, convenient installation features, and compatibility with underfloor heating wiring centres, this thermal actuator is a valuable addition to any heating system. HomeKit support offers:

Siri Voice Control: With HomeKit, you can ask Siri to set your Neo in each room to the desired temperature.

HomeKit Enabled: The Secure Smart Home platform from Apple.
Geo-Location Facility: Using your mobile phone position, Neo will automatically turn the heating off in your home when the last person has left and back on again when the first person is on their way home.

Comfortable Temperature: 4 Comfort levels per day, so you can, for example, have your home warm when you wake, a little lower while you are out at work, warmer in the evening while you relax, and reduced further throughout the night while you sleep.
Easy Away: Turning your heating off shouldn't be difficult - if it is, you are less likely to do it. The easy Away feature in Neo allows you to switch your home heating off from anywhere. Even in Away mode, we have your home covered providing frost protection in your home.
Convenient Profiles: Re-programming your comfort levels as and when your schedule changes is a thing of the past. A profile is a set of comfort levels that you can activate at any time from the app.
Always Updated: Your neoHub will automatically download feature enhancements and bug fixes, automatically updating all of your neoStats.

Designed with a height of 1800mm and a length of 300mm, this slim profile unit is ideal for installations where wall space is limited but heating demands remain high. The model operates under a maximum working pressure of 10 bar, demonstrating its capability to handle standard high-pressure hydronic heating systems with ease. This high pressure rating provides heating engineers and installers with the assurance of reliability and long-term durability on site.

The design is a particular favourite among architects who value its understated appearance and clean lines. Its slim profile ensures it integrates discreetly into any room layout without protruding excessively. product.name: ATC Almeria Eco Digital Panel Heater White 2000 W DPH2000-ECO
product.description:
The ATC Almeria Eco Digital Panel Heater is a versatile and energy-efficient heating solution. With its white finish and sleek design, this heater is perfect for installation in a wide range of environments, including residential, commercial, educational, and healthcare. The heater offers simple and effective controls, including a large, easy-to-read thin-film transistor screen, making it fast and easy to program.

The heater can be operated in either programmable mode or manual mode, allowing you to choose the best option for your needs. It features a range of energy-saving features, including an electronic thermostat, open window technology, and a range of adjustable operating modes and temperature settings, including comfort, economy, and boost.

Trustworthy Quality

product.name: UltraFloor Prime IT Multi-Surface Primer
product.description:
Prime IT MSP is a versatile, water-based acrylic primer, sealer, and bonding aid suitable for a wide range of substrates, both porous and non-porous.

Key Features:

Moisture Tolerant: Ideal for use on substrates with varying moisture levels, ensuring reliable performance even in challenging conditions.
Enhances Adhesion: Improves bonding between substrates and subsequent materials, promoting strong and durable adhesion.
Reduces Pinholing: Helps minimize the occurrence of pinholes, ensuring a smooth and even surface for subsequent applications.
High Coverage: Covers up to 200m² at a 3:1 dilution ratio, providing excellent value for large-scale projects.
Can Be Used as a Curing Agent: Functions as a curing agent, facilitating the proper curing and bonding of subsequent materials.
Size: Available in a 5-liter container, suitable for both small-scale and large-scale applications.
Calculation Guidelines:
For porous surfaces: Apply one coat at a 3:1 dilution ratio, followed by one coat at a 1:1 dilution ratio.
For non-porous surfaces: Apply one neat coat of MSP.
Prime IT MSP is the ideal solution for stabilizing and consolidating substrate surfaces, enhancing adhesion, and ensuring the success of multi-layer applications. Upgrade your projects with Prime IT MSP for reliable results and superior performance.

ProWarm BACKER-PRO insulation boards offer superior waterproofing and heat insulation for underfloor heating and tile applications. Wide Range of Thickness Options: Available in 6mm, 10mm, 12.5mm, 20mm, 30mm, and 50mm thicknesses, offering versatility to accommodate various installation requirements and insulation needs.
Approved by Tile Adhesive Manufacturer Instarmac -Ultra: Rigorously tested and approved by Instarmac -Ultra, ensuring compatibility and reliability.
Excellent Sound Insulation: Effectively reduces impact sound, creating a quieter and more comfortable environment.
Easy Installation: Can be easily cut with a knife, eliminating the need for complex tools like a jigsaw. Suitable for installation on both floors and walls.
Dimensional Stability: Waterproof and exhibits excellent dimensional stability, maintaining integrity and performance even in wet room environments.
Enhance your underfloor heating and tiling projects with ProWarm BACKER-PRO insulation boards. Their exceptional waterproofing, insulation properties, and ease of installation make them the ideal choice for creating a reliable and efficient heating system with a durable tile surface.

product.name: ProWarm Ultra Prime Surface Conditioner 0.5L
product.description:
Ultraprime is an acrylic surface conditioner designed to enhance bonding on various building substrates, including plaster, timber, brick, and blockwork (porous surfaces). Here are its key features and specifications:

Versatile and Durable: Suitable for a variety of substrates, Ultraprime offers durability and reliability in bonding applications.
Increases Bond Strength: Enhances the adhesion of subsequent layers, ensuring a strong and lasting bond between materials.
Improves Water Resistance: Provides improved resistance to water penetration, enhancing the longevity of bonded surfaces.
Improves Flexibility: Enhances the flexibility of bonded surfaces, reducing the risk of cracking or damage due to movement.
Seals and Primes: Functions as both a sealer and primer, preparing the surface for further treatment or finishing.
Use with Porous Substrates: Specifically formulated for use on porous substrates such as plaster, timber, brick, and blockwork.
Specifications:

Packaging: Available in 0.5 Litres containers.
Coverage: Can cover up to 7m² per coat, depending on the porosity of the substrate.
Storage: Store in airtight containers between 5°C and 30°C. Protect from frost to maintain product integrity.
Shelf Life: Has a shelf life of 6 months under the specified storage conditions.
Ultraprime offers a reliable solution for enhancing bond strength and improving water resistance on various building substrates. With its versatility, durability, and ease of use, it is an ideal choice for bonding applications in construction and renovation projects.

product.name: ProWarm ProGrid+ Heating Mat - 1m
product.description:
The ProWarm ProGrid+ Heating Mat represents a cutting-edge solution designed to simplify the installation process of loose electric underfloor heating cables. Bid farewell to cumbersome installations and embrace efficiency and convenience.

Crafted with innovation in mind, the ProGrid+ matting features a unique grid system tailored to effortlessly accommodate the electric heating cable within its grooves. No more wrestling with tape or fixings – the pre-spaced design ensures precise placement, enabling users to achieve their desired heat output per square meter effortlessly.

But there's more. The ProGrid+ matting not only houses the cable but also acts as a robust decoupling membrane. This critical feature serves as a shield against reflective cracking, a common issue caused by shrinkage cracks, board joints, and lateral movement. With ProGrid+, rest assured that your underfloor heating system will remain resilient and durable over time.

Wide Range of Thickness Options: Available in 6mm, 10mm, 12.5mm, 20mm, 30mm, and 50mm thicknesses, offering versatility to accommodate various installation requirements and insulation needs.

Dimensional Stability: Waterproof and exhibits excellent dimensional stability, maintaining integrity and performance even in wet room environments.
Enhance your underfloor heating and tiling projects with ProWarm BACKER-PRO insulation boards. Their exceptional waterproofing, insulation properties, and ease of installation make them the ideal choice for creating a reliable and efficient heating system with a durable tile surface.

product.name: Reliance Water Controls Water Shock Arrestor 12.7mm Xves050000
product.description: Shock arrestors are used to prevent water hammer. Water hammer is caused by shock waves running through the water system which create noise, or in severe cases pipe movement within the system. Reverberations are a series of shock waves in quick succession. The pressure wave in such circumstances can be up to three times greater than the standing pressure. Water hammer occurs when the flow rate is suddenly changed e.g. when a valve is quickly closed quarter turn lever operated taps or solenoid valves are two of the main culprits. Reverberations occur when system components have moving parts which respond to an initial shock wave by trying to open or close. The Reliance Water Controls shock arrestor is a mini expansion vessel which works by absorbing the shock wave from the fitting so that it does not travel through the system and cause noise. The closer the shock arrestor is installed to the fitting the better.

The Edel RF Domestic hot water heat pump cylinder in 200L capacity models with a highly efficient heat pump which produces domestic hot water effectively and reduces dwelling emissions.

Suitable for medium dwellings or commercial buildings which need reliable hot water from a heat pump.

The Edel hot water cylinder consumes much less electricity than standard electric boilers leading to lower electricity bills for the same amount of hot water. Comprising of an inner stainless steel vessel, the hot water heat pump is mounted on top to efficiently produce hot water by extracting heat from external air via insulated ducting (available separately).

product.name: Dim 270L Hot Water Heat Pump Cyl 101594
product.description: The Dimplex 270 litre EDEL model hot water heat pump is a highly efficient way to heat water for domestic purposes.  This large 270 litre cylinder has a heat pump mounted on top which has a COP of 3.36, making it several times more efficient than a equivalent electric water heater and suitable for a large house.  Complete with a sound proof hood, it is designed to be installed indoors, and can be placed near where the hot water is required.

product.name: Tado Add-On Smart Radiator Thermostat For Multi-Room Control
product.description:
Never heat your whole home again! tado' Smart Radiator Thermostats can replace your existing thermostatic radiator valves and provide room-by-room scheduling and control, so you can enjoy greater comfort and improve the efficiency of your heating system. To benefit from tado' Smart Radiator Thermostats, you must also install a tado' Starter Kit.

The highly rated tado' app enables you to individually schedule and control each Smart Radiator Thermostat from anywhere, as well as providing insights and reports about the climate of individual rooms and showing you the energy savings made by tado''. tado' is also compatible with Amazon Alexa, Apple HomeKit and Google Assistant. product.name: Intergas Xtreme 24kW Combi Boiler NG 35004
product.description:
The Intergas Xtreme natural gas combi boiler delivers a 24kW heat output and operates on a 20% hydrogen blend. An integrated passive flue gas heat recovery (PFGHR) unit reclaims wasted heat to minimise fuel consumption and lowering CO2 emissions. Nitrogen oxide emissions are kept between 17.06mg/kWh and 20.33mg/kWh for reduced environmental impact. 

Domestic hot water is supplied at a flow rate between 11 and 14.5 litres per minute. Twin OpenTherm outlets are built into the unit to enable dual-zone thermostatic control. A factory-fitted RF module enables remote access and digital adjustments via compatible controls. 

Installation uses a single combined pipe connection for both the pressure relief valve and condensate discharge line. Fitting an Intergas system filter at the same time as installation extends the standard unit warranty coverage to 12 years upon registration.

Connect the pressure hose to the equipment to be tested with valve V1 opened and valve V2 closed.
Open one or several purge points in the installation. Remove the handle-locking hook and pump liquid until all air has been purged from the system. Close the vent points and then fill the installation operating the pump handle with ample movements.
Keep on pumping until the test pressure has been reached.
Close valve V1.
If the test pressure is exceeded during the pumping operation, slightly open valve V2 until the required pressure is attained. Then close all Valves.

product.name: ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat (Wood, Vinyl & Carpet) - 2.0 M2
product.description:
Introducing the ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat - the perfect solution for those seeking a comfortable and efficient way to heat their wooden, vinyl, and carpet floors. This innovative product is designed to provide consistent and controllable warmth throughout any wooden flooring, from engineered boards to laminate and hardwood, as well as for vinyl or carpet floors.

The ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat is easy to install and is compatible with most types of floating floors, ensuring a quick and hassle-free installation process. It features a high-quality heating foil that provides reliable and even heat distribution throughout any floor.

Backed by an industry-leading lifetime warranty, the ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat provides peace of mind, ensuring you can enjoy the benefits of underfloor heating for years to come. Upgrade your home's heating system with the ProWarm Wood Underfloor Heating Mat and experience the ultimate in comfort and energy efficiency today.

Installation Requirements
These mats MUST be installed in conjunction with ProFoam or XPS Insulation.
When installing carpet/vinyl flooring, Heat-Pak Dual Overlay must also be used.
Ensure that the carpet and underlay combined tog value does not exceed 2.0. Note that in most cases, when carpet is laid, underfloor heating cannot be used as a primary heat source.
Kit Contents
ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat: Available in single, double, or triple mat configurations for areas over 12m2.
Digital Thermostat: Take control of your comfort with our range of programmable digital thermostats, each equipped with a floor temperature probe.
Adhesive Tape: Ensures a secure installation, keeping the mat or cable in place for a flawless finish.
Conduit: Adds an extra layer of durability and reliability to your heating system.
Specifications
The ProWarm Foil system is an ultra-thin electric radiant floor heating system primarily for use under laminate, engineered wood, glued hardwood, and other floating floors.
Made with Fluoropolymer insulated heating cables sandwiched between two layers of specially reinforced aluminum foil.
Uniform spacing of the heating elements ensures even heat distribution.
Available in heat outputs of 150 W/m2.
Hot and Cold lead junctions are uniquely designed for foolproof installation.
Meets all test requirements of IEC 60335 and SEMKO certified.
Cost-effective, flexible, and easy to install.
Provides close and uniform spacing of heating cables for higher comfort.
Wide range of heat loads and sizes ensure suitability to all kinds of floorings.

product.name: Nuaire MRXBOXAB-ECO2B Wall mounted MVHR Unit
product.description: Nuaire's MRXBOXAB-ECO2B unit has been designed with automatic 100% bypass as listed on the SAP Product Characteristics Database (PCDB). The units operate by continuously extracting moisture-laden air from ‘wet’ rooms within the property and at the same time drawing in fresh supply air from outside. The heat from the extracted stale air is recovered via a heat exchanger inside the heat recovery unit which becomes tempered then filtered before supplying into the habitable rooms, creating comfortable and well-ventilated homes. The heat exchanger block within these units can recover up to 95% of the normally wasted heat. The two independent fans have full-speed control for background and boost ventilation rates. The unit has a summer bypass function. In warmer months this function automatically activates to ensure the property is being well-ventilated and comfort levels are maintained in the home by continuously drawing in fresh filtered air into the habitable rooms.

product.name: Nuaire Drimaster Loft Mounted Positive Input Ventilation System DRI-ECO-HEAT-HC
product.description: Drimaster-Eco Positive Input Ventilation (PIV) ventilation systems are the most effective method of curing and preventing condensation dampness. Recommended for planned and reactive ventilation servicing, essentially the concept is to introduce fresh, filtered air into the dwelling at a continuous rate, encouraging movement of air from inside to outside. To achieve this, the unit is mounted in the loft space, drawing air through the filters and inputting it, at ceiling level, into the property. An integrated heater tempers airflow should the temperature in the loft space drop below a set point, ensuring ultimate comfort in the home.

product.name: Vaillant EcoTec Pro 24 24kW Combi Boiler 10021836
product.description: The Vaillant ecoTEC Pro 24 Combi Boiler uses a natural gas fuel supply and is perfect for 1-3 bedroom properties with a single bathroom. It is typically popular for installation in small to medium sized houses, flats and bungalows. Vaillant's ecoTEC Pro range of combi boilers provides some of the best value boilers on the market, offering renowned quality at the best possible price. The Pro 24 combi boiler is also fully compliant with the latest ErP regulations, so you can rest assured that you are getting one of the most efficient and reliable boilers around. The Vaillant Pro 24 combi boiler is able to supply the central heating and hot water by heating the mains water supply, negating the need for a hot water cylinder or cold water feed tank, thus saving space and installation time, and providing hot water on demand.

product.name: Vaillant EcoTec Pro 28 28kW LPG Combi Boiler 10021838
product.description: The Vaillant EcoTec Pro 28 LPG combi boiler is a wall-mounted, stainless steel gas boiler delivering 28 kW of heat with an A energy rating, making it suitable for homes requiring efficient central heating and instant hot water. Supplied in white, it includes a standard horizontal flue and a clock, offers a temperature range of 30 to 85 C, and comes with a 3-year guarantee for added peace of mind. product.name: Vaillant EcoTec Pro 28 28kW Combi Boiler with Horizontal Flue Pack 10221837
product.description: Vaillant designed this 28kW combination boiler and horizontal flue pack to provide central heating and domestic hot water without the need for a storage cylinder or a loft-mounted cold water tank. This ErP A-rated appliance achieves a SAP 2009 annual efficiency rating of 89.3 per cent. The unit features a stainless steel heat exchanger and includes a filling loop. Measuring 720 mm high, 440 mm wide, and 338 mm deep, the boiler fits into limited spaces while delivering rapid hot water directly to your taps.

product.name: Vaillant EcoTec Pro 24 24kW Combi Boiler with Horizontal Flue Pack 10021836
product.description: Vaillant has engineered the EcoTec Pro 24 combi boiler with a 24kW heat output and an included horizontal flue pack. This unit features removable side panels alongside a push fit flue system to improve accessibility during installation. It achieves an efficiency rating of up to 89.3 percent under SAP 2009 standards. A fully modulating low NOx burner and integrated fan regulate combustion efficiency. Built in two stage frost protection maintains boiler performance throughout cold periods. Eliminating the need for a separate hot water cylinder or loft-mounted cold water storage tank, this compact combi system supplies hot water directly to taps.

product.name: Vaillant EcoTec Pro 24 24kW Combi Boiler with Vertical Flue Pack 10021836
product.description: Engineered by Vaillant, the ecoTEC Pro combi boiler delivers a 24kW output and includes a vertical flue pack under product code 10021836 505307. This unit features removable side panels and a push-fit flue system to simplify fitting and routine maintenance access. A patented stainless-steel main exchanger and matching secondary heat exchanger optimize heat transfer during use. A pneumatic air and gas modulation mechanism automatically adjusts fuel combustion to refine performance. Its fully modulating low NOx burner and fan adjust output dynamically to reduce emissions. product.name: Rothenberger Press Ring M22 1000003883
product.description: The high-quality M profile press rings have been specially designed and developed by ROTHENBERGER for pressing applications on metallic piping systems. product.name: Global Energy Systems Filternator 28mm Filter PA599
product.description: The patent pending, high performance, ecient stainless steel Filternator is engineered to deliver durable, long life, eective filtration of your heating system and is designed not to restrict the flow even at high flow rates. It�s very important to keep a high flow rate through a heat pump circuit to maintain efficiency and longevity of the heat pump by keeping any debris free from the heat pump heat exchanger. The Filternator is designed with easy installation in mind and it�s possible to install the Filternator inline or horizontally.

product.name: Adey System Diagnostics Test Kit Cp1-03-06460
product.description:
Designed specifically for commercial and industrial heating and chilled systems, the new System Diagnostics Test Kit highlights the most typical water quality issues, providing an easy way for you to understand your system health.  
For Contractors, Facilities and Commercial Plant Room Managers who want to actively test, monitor and improve water quality of commercial heating and chilled systems, the kit includes access to a suite of pre-paid water tests providing a snapshot of system water condition to highlight any potential issues.
Going beyond the basics of confirmation and validation of system cleaning/flushing and inhibitor dosing, results provide you with actionable system diagnostics to help inform further action.
Analysis is independently carried out by Alpha Scientific, part of the ADEY Group.

product.name: Unbranded Daewoo 2000W Portable Upright Fan Heater HEA1138
product.description:
Compact Yet Powerful Heating
Elevate your comfort at home with the Daewoo 2000W Portable Upright Fan Heater. Designed to deliver efficient warmth, this heater is perfect for small rooms like bedrooms, home offices, or dormitories. Its powerful 2000W output quickly heats up spaces, ensuring you stay cosy during the coldest days. With two heat settings—1000W for a gentle warmth and 2000W for a more intense heat—you can easily adjust the temperature to suit your needs.
 
Versatile All-Season Comfort
This fan heater isn't just for winter. With its cooling 'fan only' setting, it doubles up as a cooling fan during warmer months, providing year-round comfort in a single appliance. The adjustable thermostat allows you to maintain the perfect temperature, while the power indicator light keeps you informed of its operation.
 
Portable and Easy to Use
Weighing just 0.9kg, this heater is incredibly lightweight and easy to move from room to room. Its built-in carry handle adds to its portability, making it convenient to position wherever you need it most. Whether you’re moving it around the house or taking it to a caravan, this heater is designed for effortless use.
 
Safety and Reliability
Your safety is a top priority with the Daewoo 2000W Fan Heater. It comes equipped with overheat protection, automatically shutting off if it gets too hot, ensuring peace of mind during use. Additionally, its sturdy construction and reliable performance are backed by a 3-year extended warranty upon registration, offering long-term reassurance.

product.name: Prowarm Laminon Underfloor Heating Grid - 1.25m x 100m 1102S
product.description:
Designed specifically for the underfloor heating market, the Laminon Underfloor Heating Grid 120m2 - this grid serves as a foundation for the installation of underfloor heating pipes, ensuring proper spacing and alignment for an efficient and effective system.

The Laminon Underfloor Heating Grid is crafted with high-strength, woven fabric that is coated in specialist polypropylene. This unique combination of materials guarantees durability and reliability, allowing for a seamless installation process and ensuring optimal performance from the very beginning.

With its reinforced coated woven fabric, the Laminon grid offers exceptional tensile strength, providing a secure base for the underfloor heating pipes. This prevents any tearing or damage to the material during the screeding process, ensuring a smooth and flawless installation.

For added convenience and precision, each roll of Laminon grid comes with a printed grid pattern as standard. This grid serves as a guide, ensuring accurate spacing for both the pipes and clips every time. Say goodbye to guesswork and hello to a hassle-free installation process.

With a generous roll size of 100m x 1.25m, the Laminon Underfloor Heating Grid covers an impressive area of 125m2. This provides ample coverage for various room sizes and configurations, making it suitable for both residential and commercial applications.

Invest in the reliability and efficiency of your underfloor heating system with the Laminon Underfloor Heating Grid 125m2. Experience the benefits of a sturdy and well-organized foundation, ensuring a successful and long-lasting underfloor heating installation.

product.name: Prowarm 16mm Pert-EVOH-PERT Pipe 300m 1827198021
product.description:
The Pert-Evoh-Pert Pipe is a high-quality and versatile piping solution designed for various heating and plumbing applications. It offers exceptional flexibility, durability, and performance, ensuring reliable and efficient operation in your systems.

Lightweight and Ultra Flexible

The Pert-Evoh-Pert Pipe is specifically engineered to be lightweight and ultra-flexible, making it incredibly easy to handle, bend, and install. Its flexibility allows for hassle-free routing around obstacles and tight corners, reducing installation time and effort.

Compliance with Standards

Rest assured that the Pert-Evoh-Pert Pipe meets the highest industry standards. It complies with the requirements of EN ISO 21003 and DIN 4726, ensuring its reliability and performance in heating and plumbing systems. You can trust its quality and compatibility with other components in your installations.

Oxygen Diffusion Barrier

The pipe features an oxygen diffusion barrier that completely encases the inner layer of PE-RT (Polyethylene of Raised Temperature Resistance). This barrier effectively prevents the entry of oxygen into the heating system through the pipe, safeguarding against corrosion and maintaining the integrity of the system over time.

Durable and Corrosion-Resistant

The Pert-Evoh-Pert Pipe is constructed entirely of plastics, providing a uniform and non-reactive structure. This design ensures its durability, corrosion resistance, and resistance to chemical reactions with metals commonly found in heating and plumbing systems. It offers long-lasting performance and reduces the risk of pipe degradation or failure.

Whether you're working on a residential or commercial project, the Pert-Evoh-Pert Pipe offers reliability, flexibility, and longevity. Its superior characteristics make it an ideal choice for various heating and plumbing applications where durability, performance, and ease of installation are paramount.

product.description:
The ProWarm Manifold Ball Valve Pair is a dependable and adaptable option for managing the water flow in your heating system. Two 1 inch ball valves are included in this set, each nickel plated for increased durability and corrosion resistance.

The ball valves are 1 inch male to 1 inch female working perfectly with the ProWarm manifolds. The ball valves also feature EPDM rubber seals making for a more reliable connection, ensuring a water tight seal. The set comes in an easy-to-identify red and blue pair, making it possible to distinguish between the flow and return pipes.

These ball valves guarantee enduring performance and dependable operation thanks to their sturdy design and premium materials. The valves' lifespan is increased and their smooth performance is maintained throughout time thanks to the nickel plating's additional layer of protection.

The ball valves feature a quarter-turn handle, allowing for quick and effortless control of the water flow. When the handle is parallel to the pipe, the valve is fully open, enabling maximum flow. Conversely, when the handle is perpendicular to the pipe, the valve is fully closed, completely stopping the flow of water.

Installing the Manifold Ball Valve Pair is a straightforward process. Simply connect the valves to the corresponding flow and return pipes of your manifold using the appropriate fittings.

By incorporating ball valves into your heating system, you gain greater control and flexibility. These valves enable you to isolate specific circuits or components, making maintenance and repairs more convenient. They also allow for efficient system flushing and balancing, ensuring optimal performance and energy efficiency.

Whether you're installing a new heating system or upgrading an existing one, the Manifold Ball Valve Pair is a reliable choice. Experience the convenience, versatility, and peace of mind that comes with having full control over your heating system's water flow.
