product.name: Baxi Pressure Switch Kit 226060
product.description: Baxi Pressure Switch Kit in heating appliances help to control various aspects of the internal pressure of closed systems and boilers. Pressure switches can be related to water, gas or air and are used to restrict or allow the flow of specific materials based on pressure variables.

product.name: Baxi Burner Assembly 133HE and 130HE 245199
product.description: Baxi branded burner assembly is intended for use in the burner section of Baxi Combi (condensing) boilers. The burner produces heat in a combustible heating appliance. In natural gas appliances, gas is transferred to a valve and into the burner for ignition. The heat created is used to heat the water in the master heat exchanger.

product.name: Baxi Sensor Temperature Assembled 5106471
product.description: The thermistor decreases the current resistance in a manner that is inversely proportional to the temperature of the thermistor. The electronic control sends a current to the thermistor and can tell whether a decrease or increase in heat is needed.

product.name: Baxi Domestic Hot Water 12 Plate Heat Exchanger 248047
product.description: The Baxi domestic hot water 12 plate heat exchanger is found on the Baxi Combi 80 Maxflue and Baxi Combi 80E boilers. The part is in the hydraulics section of the boilers and is used to transfer heat from the combustion unit to the hot water system, which is used by the taps.

product.name: Baxi Burner Boiler WM532 RS BER552 102136
product.description: Baxi Wall-Mounted burner bar is the primary heating source for the heating appliance. Within the appliance, the gas travels through the pipework to the gas control valve and then on to the burner bar, where it is ignited by the pilot light. The high temperature produced is then used to heat the water within the boiler's main heat exchanger.

product.name: Valor Control Knob Black 5111573
product.description: The Valor control knob is located on one of the front spindles and allows the user to manually control certain aspects of the fire's operation. Some fires allow the user to change the temperature, while others allow the user to change the current function. This means that the user has the ability to control the size of the flame within the fire burner.

product.name: Baxi Pilot Ignition Electrode 225934
product.description: The Baxi pilot ignition electrode is responsible for causing the spark that begins combustion within the burner The flame sensing electrodes are responsible for monitoring whether there is a flame present in the burner. This is an important safety device that makes sure the boiler isn't still supplying gas without a flame.

product.name: Baxi Control Knob Assembly 043115
product.description: The Baxi control knob resides on one of the spindles located on the front of the appliance and allows the user to manually control certain aspects of the boiler's operation. Some of the boilers enable to change the temperature, while others allow to alter the current function. This means the user can have the boiler generate hot water without the central heating being turned on and vice versa.

product.name: Baxi Electric Printed Circuit Board 237730

product.name: Mapei Keraflex Maxi S1 Flexible Floor Tile Adhesive Grey 20Kg
product.description: Mapei Keraflex Maxi S1 Flexible Floor Tile Adhesive is a high performance, deformable cementitious adhesive with extended open time and no vertical slip. It is suitable for ceramic tiles with a very low emission level of volatile organic compounds. Keraflex Maxi S1 Flexible Floor Tile Adhesive is ideal for the installation of large-size porcelain tiles and natural stone. It is composed of cement and fine graded sands and contains high levels of synthetic resins and special additives. When mixed with water it has low viscosity making it easy to work with and it can be applied on a vertical surface without sagging or even with large or heavy tiles. Keraflex Maxi S1 hardens, even when very thickly applied, with minimal shrinkage and extended open and adjustability time. Also available in white.

product.name: Worcester Bosch HVO Conversion Kit 12/18 18kW (DM/HS II) 7731600278
product.description:
We offer HVO conversion kits suitable for our entire oil boiler range manufactured after September 2018. These new kits enable our oil boilers to be safely and efficiently converted to operate on HVO.

All of our oil boilers were tested on HVO to find the correct combination of burner components and settings to match the performance on kerosene. Our HVO kits contain labels for the appliance, burner and oil tank, with updated information regarding HVO. Typically, the kits contain a nozzle, flame sensor and replacement oil valve. Some of our conversion kits contain additional components such as an air damper disc or burner recirculation tube, depending on boiler model and output, in order for each variation of appliance to perform as efficiently as possible.​

product.name: hansgrohe sBox Finish set square, Chrome 28010000
product.description:
Designed by Hansgrohe, this chrome finish set stores the shower hose beneath the bathtub rim. The hose extends up to a 1.45 m length for flexible bath use. A square escutcheon with an easy-clean chrome finish provides a protective cover on the bath.

Suitable for bath rims with a minimum width of 71 mm, the package includes a hose box, shower hose, square escutcheon, mounting material and assembly instructions. The standard G1/2 hose connector links to conventional hand showers and features a holder that stops the fitting falling beneath the tub.

Installation requires the sBox basic set under art. no. 13560180, which is sold separately. For tile installations, an installation plate under art. no. 28016000 and two mounting angles under art. no. 28021000 are required.

Compared with the previous Hansgrohe Secuflex system, this unit offers 30% greater hose extension length, 50% reduced pull-out traction and 60% lower holding force. An alternative oval escutcheon design is also available under art. no. 28020000.

product.name: Hansgrohe Logis Basin Mixer Tap 70 LowPairessure without waste set, Chrome 71071010
product.description:
Hansgrohe finished this low pressure basin mixer tap in chrome. A ComfortZone clearance height of 70 mm provides space above the sink. Operation uses a single lever handle fitted with an internal ceramic cartridge. 

At a low working pressure of 0.2 bar, the tap delivers a normal spray pattern with an output flow rate of 4 litres per minute. An adjustable temperature limitation feature protects against high heat, allowing safe integration with continuous flow water heaters. 

Installation uses DN15 sized inlets with G ½ connections and an included G ½ by G ½ adapter. This tap is supplied without a waste set.

product.name: Hansgrohe Metris Basin Mixer Tap 110 LowPairessure without waste set, Chrome 31084010
product.description: Hansgrohe designed this chrome basin mixer tap with a ComfortZone height of 110 mm to provide clearance above the sink bowl. The single lever handle operates an internal ceramic cartridge for precise control over water volume. Operating at a low pressure of 0.2 bar, it delivers a flow rate of 4 litres per minute. An adjustable temperature limitation feature allows you to set a maximum heat threshold. Installation requires DN15 fittings, using G 1/2 inch connections supplied with a G 1/2 by G 1/2 adapter. Identified by model code 31084010, this unit is supplied without a waste set.

product.name: Hansgrohe Focus M41 Kitchen Mixer Tap 240, pull-out sPairay, 2jet, Stainless Steel Stainless Steel Finish 31815800
product.description: Hansgrohe designed the Focus M41 single-lever tap 240 featuring a 230 mm ComfortZone height above the sink to fit tall pots. Its spout hose extends by approximately 50 cm, combined with a selectable 110 degree or 150 degree swivel range. A button on the spout switches between a laminar spray for rapid filling and a shower spray for cleaning fruit and vegetables. The selected jet mode remains preset after turning off the water supply. A MagFit magnetic slot docks the spray head centrally into position when retracted. Water flow and temperature are adjusted using a ceramic mixer cartridge. The stainless steel surface finish is durable against scratches due to its physical vapour deposition (PVD) coating. Limescale deposits wipe away easily from the silicone QuickClean insert on the spout. This unit operates with continuous flow heaters, backed by a 15 year spare parts availability guarantee following range discontinuation.

product.name: Hansgrohe Logis Basin Mixer Tap 100 LowPairessure without waste set, Chrome 71101010
product.description: Hansgrohe designed this chrome basin mixer tap with a ComfortZone 100 height to ensure adequate space above the sink. Smooth water control is managed via a single lever handle built with an internal ceramic cartridge. Safety features include an adjustable temperature limitation function to help set maximum heat thresholds. Designed for low-pressure installations, the unit produces a flow rate of 4 l/min at 0.2 bar. It connects to DN15 plumbing setups via G ½ inlet fittings supplied with a G ½ x G ½ adapter. This tap functions with instantaneous water heaters and is supplied without a waste set. The product reference code for this fitting is 71101010.

product.name: Hansgrohe Vernis Blend Basin Mixer Tap 100 with bidette hand shower and shower hose 160 cm, Chrome 71215000
product.description:
Hansgrohe designed the Vernis Blend single lever basin tap with a 160 cm shower hose and a matching bidet hand shower in a chrome finish. The 150 mm diameter hand shower head features three spray modes: RainAir, CaresseAir and Mix. Users can switch between spray settings using the integrated Select button. 

Integrated EcoSmart technology automatically limits the water flow rate to a maximum of 9 litres per minute. The AirPower feature enriches water with air to produce a fuller spray that minimises splashing. A Hansgrohe ceramic mixer system controls water volume and temperature via a single handle.

The all new ROFROST Turbo 28 is the latest addition to the Pipe Freezing programme and has been specifically designed for rapid and reliable freezing of domestic pipework. Covering all domestic pipe sizes with alloy adaptors for 8-10-12-15-22mm with the master freeze clamp fitting directly onto 28mm pipe. Copper, plastic composite, steel and stainless steel (1/4"-11/4") can also be frozen using the ROFROST

High-quality electronic tap: robust, stylish, affordable - the professional solution.
The Vernis Blend electronic basin mixer with preset temperature and mains connection (230 V) is your professional solution for public and semi-public washrooms. Wherever safe hygiene, permanently reliable function, and low operating costs are required, the sensor tap of the hansgrohe Vernis Blend line is the first choice. The water temperature can be flexibly preset, so there is no need for a separate operating lever. This allows for 100% touch-free hand washing. Hygiene is improved, especially in those places where there are many different users, such as public wash rooms in restaurants, as well as in schools or hospitals and nursing homes.
Additional benefit: the infrared sensor ensures that water flows only when needed. Since less water needs to be heated, it lowers energy costs. The elegant hansgrohe design looks great and is swiftly cleaned: no hidden corners or edges for dirt to collect in
Quality down to the last detail.
The solid metal mixer body looks like it has been milled from solid metal. The robust and durable design reduces service costs. product.description: This part is located within the heat exchanger section. There are two different types of heat exchanger that can be present, the primary heat exchanger and the secondary heat exchanger. The primary is present in almost all boilers and it allows the heat to be transferred from the burner to the water within the system. The secondary heat exchanger only appears on combination boilers and allows the heat to be transferred between two closed systems. The Primary Heat exchanger is also known as a "main" heat exchanger or heat engine. The secondary heat exchanger can also be known as the domestic hot water heat exchanger or the plate heat exchanger .

product.name: Valway Thermostatic Dual Head Bar Mixer Shower - Brushed Brass, Round, Cool Touch
product.description:
Valway has designed this exposed dual-outlet mixer shower system with a brushed brass finish and round detailing. The main overhead drencher measures 200mm in width and features an adjustable ball joint for targeted spray positioning. Thermostatic temperature control regulates the water flow to maintain a stable output, while cool touch technology prevents the bar casing from becoming hot during operation. 

Both the fixed overhead drencher and the separate handset operate with a single spray pattern. A 1500mm hose connects to the handset to provide extended reach across the showering area. Built for wall-fed installation, the unit features standard 150mm pipe centres and 15.2mm push-fit inlet connection fittings. The shower operates across water supply pressures between 0.5 bar and 5 bar, making it compatible with combi boilers as well as low-pressure and high-pressure plumbing setups.
